description: Take one item off one of the member's lists. Give itemId (from kineticist_get_my_lists), or give id, the game, location, theme or community item itself. An item that isn't on the list changes nothing and the answer says so. The thing itself isn't deleted from Kineticist. Can't be used on the system lists. Needs the member signed in to Kineticist from this app; an API key can't delete. Acts on the caller's own Kineticist account (the signed-in member, or the API key owner). Agents that make many calls per task use up a free account's daily allowance quickly.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

id.description: The game, location, theme or community item to take off, instead of itemId.

itemId.description: The list item's id (item_id in the list).

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: kineticist_remove_from_list
title: Remove from a list
